## File: verify-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu definition for verification workflows (verify against
## reference object, multi-selection checks, diffs). Loaded by menu
## loaders and runtime UI.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.verify
  name: "Verify Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Menu for verification, version, diff, and semantic operations."

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.verify-against-reference-object"
    label: "Verify Against Reference Object"
    description: "Verify selected objects against a reference object or exemplar."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-verify-reference"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: null
    visibility_condition: "reference_object_selected"

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.verify-multi-selection"
    label: "Verify Multi-Selection"
    description: "Verify multiple selected objects using type-compatible operations."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-verify-multi"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2.1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.run-sequential-validation"
    label: "Run Sequential Validation"
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-verify-sequence"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2.2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.run-collective-validation"
    label: "Run Collective Validation"
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-verify-collective"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.apply-version-change-to-selection"
    label: "Apply Version Change to Selection"
    description: "Forward or backward version remapping for selected objects."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-version-apply"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.diff-panel"
    label: "Diff Panel"
    description: "Cross-type diffing using semantic key/value matching."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-diff-compatible"
    ui_framework: menu
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "5"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.semantic-primitive-extraction"
    label: "Semantic Primitive Extraction"
    description: "Extract semantic primitive metadata from the current context."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.semantic-primitive-extract"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "6"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.semantic-dependency-graph"
    label: "Semantic Dependency Graph"
    description: "Generate a semantic dependency graph for active primitives."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.semantic-dependency-graph"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "7"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.verify.semantic-bundle"
    label: "Semantic Bundle"
    description: "Generate and archive semantic bundle output."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.semantic-bundle"

    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
